reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text: I do not think I need to convince anyone to use this sun cream. It is one of my favourites and I will use this product until the end of time. Hydrating, calming, feels lovely on the skin and it does not break a bank. I am forever a big fan of Skin1004, and this cream is one of the reasons why.
reviews.zh: 我唔覺得需要特登去游說任何人用呢隻防曬。佢係我最鍾意嘅產品之一，我會用到天荒地老。保濕、舒緩，搽喺皮膚上面感覺好舒服，價錢都唔貴。我永遠都係 Skin1004 嘅大粉絲，而呢隻 cream 係其中一個原因。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text:
HYDRATING CENTELLA CARE – Formulated with Hyalu-Cica complex combining Hyaluronic Acid and Centella Asiatica Extract to help soothe and hydrate skin. This moisturizing centella sunscreen helps maintain a refreshed, plump looking complexion.
LIGHTWEIGHT SERUM-LIKE TEXTURE – A watery SKIN1004 sunscreen formula that absorbs quickly with no white cast, helping skin feel comfortable and smooth. Designed as an easy-to-layer sunscreen that blends smoothly and layers well under makeup.
reviews.zh:
HYDRATING CENTELLA CARE – 配方加入結合咗透明質酸同積雪草萃取嘅 Hyalu-Cica 複合物，有助舒緩同保濕肌膚。呢隻保濕嘅積雪草防曬有助保持皮膚清爽、飽滿嘅狀態。
LIGHTWEIGHT SERUM-LIKE TEXTURE – SKIN1004 嘅水感防曬配方，快速吸收之餘唔會泛白，令皮膚感覺舒適平滑。設計上易於疊搽，可以順滑推開同好好咁 layer 喺妝前底霜之下。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text: It’s very light and pretty, it doesn’t leave a white cast on me, though I have a lighter skintone. It makes me glowy but it is a little greasy feeling especially after a while. Honestly a lovely product, I like it for a beach day but I prefer something more hydrating. It works well under my makeup and doesn’t dissolve so definitely a great choice just not for me!
reviews.zh: 質地好輕透又靚，搽喺我塊面唔會泛白，雖然我膚色算白。搽完皮膚會有水光感，但過一陣會有少少油笠感。老實講係一隻好正嘅產品，我鍾意去沙灘嘅時候用，但我自己比較鍾意保濕效果更強嘅。佢喺妝前打底底下用表現好好，又唔會溶妝，所以絕對係一個好選擇，只係唔係啱我用！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text: I love this sunscreen; it didn't cause me breakouts and it's not sticky. Unfortunately, the large package doesn't have a pump dispenser, which would have not so convenient for me, as I'm not very good at determining the right amount of cream for my face.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢隻防曬，佢冇令我爆瘡，又唔會黏笠。可惜大包裝嗰隻冇泵裝設計，對我嚟講唔算太方便，因為我唔太識判斷每次要搽幾多 cream 先啱。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text:
Stay away from this sunscreen sensitive skin girlies! Horrible skin reaction!

Initially when I applied this sunscreen, it stung my eyelids briefly, but overall everything was fine. The texture was beautiful, no weird smell, and no white cast. 

The next day, I applied it again and reapplied throughout the day-- these red spots, dry patches, and consistent burning sensations appeared. Please avoid!
reviews.zh:
敏感肌嘅姊妹們，呢隻防曬你哋千祈唔好掂！皮膚反應超恐怖！

最初我搽呢隻防曬嘅時候，眼蓋有短暫嘅刺痛感，但整體上冇咩事。質地好好，冇怪味，又唔會泛白。

第二日我又再搽，仲喺一日之內補搽幾次——結果就出現咗一啲紅點、乾紋同持續嘅灼熱感。請大家避免使用！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text: My eternally favorite sunscreen, it’s my fourth bottle and I just can’t get enough of it! Super hydrating and it’s amazing under makeup (I only use blush but also when I’m using foundation). I even went to the beach and ended white as a paper (I was constantly reapplying every 1 1/2 hours) the coverage it’s amazing.
reviews.zh: 我永遠嘅最愛防曬，已經係第四支，完全用唔厭！超級保濕，喺妝前打底底下用效果一流（我平時淨係用胭脂，但用粉底嘅時候都一樣得）。我去沙灘都仲係白到好似紙咁（我不停每個 1 1/2 個鐘就補搽一次），防曬效果真係超強。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text: The sunscreen is pretty good, and this is a repurchase. The packaging for the 100 mL is a squeeze tube and not an airless pump tube like the 50 mL, which makes me worry a bit more about getting all the product out. Otherwise, it’s a good sunscreen that doesn’t have a white cast and isn’t too greasy-looking. Just make sure your skincare is soaked in first or it might leave white streaks when mixed in with sunscreen.
reviews.zh: 呢隻防曬幾好用，呢個係回購。100 mL 嘅包裝係軟管設計，唔似 50 mL 嗰款係真空泵裝管，令我有啲擔心會唔會有啲 product 唧唔出嚟。除此之外，係一隻好嘅防曬，唔會泛白，望落都唔會太油笠。一定要確保你嘅護膚品已經完全吸收，否則撈埋防曬可能會有白色一撻撻。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum 100mL
reviews.text: Es mi protector solar preferido, he probado varios pero siempre vuelvo a este. Mi piel es serible y seca en algunas áreas y este protector deja mi piel calmada, bien hidratada y no deja la cara blanca. Ahora en su nueva presentación es perfecto, mayor cantidad y su aplicador es más efectivo y no desprecias producto. El de 50 ML lo que no me gustaba era el aplicador, pues cuando todavía le quedaba producto era muy difícil sacarlo, había que cortar el envase pero con este no ocurrirá.
reviews.zh: 呢隻係我最鍾意嘅防曬，我試過好幾隻但係都會返轉頭買呢隻。我嘅皮膚係敏感肌同局部偏乾，而呢隻防曬可以令到我塊面感覺舒緩、保濕得好好，又唔會令塊面白晒。而家新包裝真係完美，份量更大，個 applicator 更加有效，唔會嘥料。50 ML 嗰款我最唔鍾意嘅係個 applicator，因為當入面仲有貨嗰陣都好難唧出嚟，要剪開個樽先得，但呢款就唔會出現呢個問題。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
